textwithimage.text:
Intel Atom® processors x7000E Series, Intel® Core™ i3 processors, and Intel® Processors N Series

The TQMxE41S SMARC 2.1 module for sale here is a feature-rich SMARC 2.1 Module, powered by a range of Intel processors, including the Intel Atom® processors x7000E Series, Intel® Core™ i3 processors, and Intel® Processors N Series. This TQMxE41S SMARC 2.1 module offers FPGA engineers a versatile and efficient computing solution.

One standout feature is its flexibility in processor options, ranging from dual-core to 8-core configurations, with power efficiency ranging from 6 W to 15 W TDP. This adaptability allows FPGA engineers to select the ideal processing power for their specific application requirements.

Memory capabilities are impressive, supporting up to 16 GB of LPDDR5 with In-Band-ECC as an option, ensuring smooth and reliable operation. Additionally, it offers up to 256 GB of eMMC storage, providing ample space for data storage.

In terms of connectivity and display capabilities, the module shines with three independent high-resolution display outputs, including DP++, HDMI, and eDP/LVDS. It also features 2x 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet, high-speed PCIe, and various other I/O options, making it easy to connect peripheral components.

The TQMxE41S is designed with security in mind, featuring extended security features including TPM 2.0 support, ensuring data integrity and system protection.

This compact module measures just 82 mm x 50 mm, adhering to the SGeT SMARC 2.1 (RC1) standard, making it suitable for applications in healthcare, IoT, industry/robotics, retail, and video conferencing. With advanced CPU microarchitecture and Intel UHD Graphics Gen12, it excels in CPU single-thread/multi-thread performance, multimedia, and AI, thanks to support for AVX256 and advanced AI instruction sets (VNNI).

In conclusion, the TQMxE41S offers FPGA engineers a powerful, compact, and adaptable computing solution with a wide range of processor options and extensive connectivity for various FPGA applications.

text.text:
Features

  • Versatile Processor Options: Offers a wide range of Intel processors, from dual-core to 8-core configurations

  • Power Efficiency: Operates within a power-efficient range of 6 W to 15 W TD.

  • High Memory Capacity: Supports up to 16 GB of LPDDR5 memory with optional In-Band-ECC

  • Robust Connectivity: Three independent high-resolution display outputs, 2x 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet, 4x PCIe, USB 3.2, and SATA interfaces

  • Advanced AI and Security: Intel UHD Graphics Gen12 with AI support, including AVX256 and VNNI instruction sets, extended security features like TPM 2.0 support

table.text:
CPU
  • Intel® Core™ i3-N305 (8-Core, 1.8/3.8 GHz, 32 EU, 15 W TDP)
  • Intel® Core™ i3-N305* (8-Core, 1.0/3.8 GHz, 32 EU, 9 W cTDP)
  • Intel Atom® x7425E (4-Core, 1.5/3.4 GHz, 24 EU, RT, 12 W TDP)
  • Intel Atom® x7413E (2-Core, 1.7/3.2 GHz, 16 EU, RT, 10 W TDP)
  • Intel Atom® x7411E (2-Core, 1.0/3.2 GHz, 16 EU, RT, 6 W TDP)
  • Intel® Processor N200 (4-Core, 1.0/3.7 GHz, 32 EU, 6 W TDP)
  • Intel® Processor N97 (4-Core, 2.0/3.6 GHz, 24 EU, 12 W TDP)
  • Intel® Processor N50 (2-Core, 1.0/3.4 GHz, 16 EU, 6 W TDP)
Memory
  • LPDDR5 - 4, 8, 16 GB, with In-Band-ECC option
  • eMMC - 16, 32, 64, 128, 256 GB Industrial iNAND
  • EEPROM - 32kbit
Graphics
  • 1x eDP (4K @ 60 Hz) or Dual Channel LVDS (18/24-bit) (assembly option)
  • 1x DP++ (4K @ 60 Hz)
  • 1x DP++ (4K @ 60 Hz) or HDMI (Full-HD @ 60 Hz) (assembly option)
Communications Interfaces
  • Ethernet - 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet (Intel i226)
  • USB - 2x USB 3.2 Gen2 (up to 10 Gb/s) 
  • SATA - 1x  SATA 3.0 (up to 6 Gb/s)
Other Interfaces
  • PCIe - 4x PCIe Gen3 (up to 8 Gb/s per Lane) (div. configurations)
  • I2C
  • SMBus
  • SPI - 1x eSPI (standard) or SPI (assembly option)
  • UART - 4x Serial port (2x 16550, 2x HS-UART)
  • GPIO - 14x GPIO, incl. fan-control
  • MIPI - 2x MIPI-CSI-2 ports (limited SW support)
General
  • Dimensions - 82mm x 50mm
  • Plug-in System - SMARC 2.1 (RC1)
  • Temperature range - Standard temperature: 0°C…+60°C 
  • Power supply - Main Voltage: 4.75 V - 5.25 V / Standby Voltage: 4.75 V - 5.25 V / RTC Battery Voltage: 3 V
  • Power consumption - Power: typ. 17W / max. TBD
OS
  • Windows 10 / Windows 10 IoT Enterprise 2021 LTSC
  • Windows 11 (restricted support)
  • Linux
